craft_notes: Sthāyin: utsāha at touch-tooled ten — narrative pasts kept (UNC); tooling-and-emission song. Triśaṅku-hung kept (myth kept, unexplained — row 10); four-bearing inside. Rejected: (a) explaining Triśaṅku → killed: name works unexplained. Read aloud: FOUR-pow-ERS, IN-ward … HUNG like-TRI-śaṅ-KU.

lines: Four powers, inward, of his spirit — inside bearing —
knowing-space, inert-ground, Māyā-made — hung like Triśaṅku.
l4.sanskrit_cite: catasraś śaktyo 'ntaḥsthāḥ puṃso 'syāntaś ca dhārikāḥ cidvyomno jaḍabhūmeś ca māyāmayyas triśaṅkuvat
